data.name: Age requirement
data.text: Participant must be at least 18 years of age and of the legal age of consent in the jurisdiction in which the study is taking place at the time of signing the informed consent.

data.name: Type 2 diabetes diagnosis
data.text: Have a clinical diagnosis of T2D according to the World Health Organization (WHO) classification or other locally applicable standards for at least 6 months prior to screening (Visit 1), with HbA1c ≤10.0% (86 mmol/mol) at screening (Visit 1).

data.name: Stable T2D treatment
data.text: Are on stable treatment for T2D for at least 90 days prior to screening (Visit 1), consisting of either diet/exercise alone or up to 3 oral AHMs (excluding incretins). Note: DPP_4i are allowed.

data.name: BMI requirement
data.text: Have a BMI >27 kg/m2 at Visit 1. Note: In participants with limb amputation or limb loss, the investigator should reach out to the Lilly medical monitor for information regarding calculation of BMI.

data.name: Stable body weight
data.text: Have a stable body weight (<5% body weight change) for 90 days prior to screening at Visit 1.

data.name: History of unsuccessful dietary effort
data.text: Have a history of at least 1 self_reported unsuccessful dietary effort to reduce body weight.

data.name: Contraceptive requirements
data.text: IOCBP, INOCBP, and individuals AMAB who agree to abide by the reproductive and contraceptive requirements provided in Section 10.4. may participate in this trial. See Section 10.4 for definitions and additional requirements related to contraception. Note: Contraceptive use by participants should be consistent with local regulations regarding the methods of contraception for those participating in clinical studies.

data.name: Informed consent capability
data.text: Are capable of giving signed informed consent as described in Appendix 1, which includes compliance with the requirements and restrictions listed in the ICF and in this protocol.

data.name: Reliability and willingness to comply
data.text: Are reliable and willing to make themselves available for the duration of the study and attend required study visits, and are willing and able to follow study procedures as required, such as self_inject study intervention; store and take the provided study intervention as directed; maintain electronic study diary and paper log; complete the required questionnaires; and undergo DXA procedure. Note: if a person is unable to undergo the DXA due to physical limitations of the DXA machine, or because they have implants, hardware, or other foreign materials that may interfere with the scan according to the DXA manufacturer's specification, this will not be considered an exclusionary criterion.

data.name: Prior or planned surgical treatment for obesity
data.text: Have a prior or planned surgical treatment for obesity. Exception: The following are allowed if performed >1 year before screening (Visit 1): liposuction; cryolipolysis; or abdominoplasty.

data.name: Prior or planned endoscopic/device_based therapy for obesity
data.text: Have a prior or planned endoscopic procedure and/or device_based therapy for obesity, such as, but not limited to mucosal ablation; gastric artery embolization; laparoscopic adjustable gastric banding; intragastric balloon; or duodenal_jejunal endoluminal liner. Exception: Prior device_based therapy is acceptable if device removal was more than 6 months prior to screening (Visit 1).

data.name: Obesity induced by endocrinologic disorders or monogenetic/syndromic forms
data.text: Have obesity induced by other endocrinologic disorders, for example, Cushing Syndrome, or are diagnosed with monogenetic or syndromic forms of obesity, for example, Melanocortin 4 Receptor deficiency or Prader Willi Syndrome.

data.name: Type 1 diabetes or related conditions
data.text: Have type 1 diabetes mellitus, latent autoimmune diabetes, or history of ketoacidosis or hyperosmolar coma.

data.name: Severe hypoglycemia or hypoglycemia unawareness
data.text: Have had 1 or more episode of severe hypoglycemia and/or 1 or more episode of hypoglycemia unawareness within the 180 days prior to Visit 1. Note: Any participant that the investigator feels will not be able to communicate an understanding of hypoglycemic symptoms and the appropriate treatment of hypoglycemia should also be excluded.

data.name: High fasting glucose
data.text: Have fasting glucose >270 mg/dL (>15.0 mmol/L) confirmed by the central laboratory at screening (Visit 1).

data.name: Recent use of prohibited antihyperglycemic medications
data.text: Have taken within 90 days before screening (Visit 1) any of the following AHMs: amylin analogs; GLP_1 receptor agonists; GIP/GLP receptor agonists; or insulin.

data.name: Current or planned treatment for diabetic retinopathy and/or macular edema
data.text: Are currently receiving or planning to receive treatment for diabetic retinopathy and/or macular edema, for example, laser photocoagulation or intravitreal injections of antivascular endothelial growth factor inhibitors. Note: All participants will have a baseline fundus photography assessment prior to randomization (Visit 3). Qualifying fundus photographs obtained within 90 days before Visit 1 may be used for eligibility determination.

data.name: Renal impairment
data.text: Have renal impairment measured as eGFR <30 mL/min/1.73 m2, calculated by eGFRcr_cys formula as per Chronic Kidney Disease Epidemiology Collaboration as determined by central laboratory during screening (Visit 1).

data.name: Significant active autoimmune abnormality
data.text: Have evidence of significant, active autoimmune abnormality, for example, lupus or rheumatoid arthritis, that, in the opinion of the investigator, is likely to require concurrent treatment with systemic glucocorticoids during the course of the study.

data.name: Recent acute myocardial infarction or cardiovascular event
data.text: Have had within 90 days prior to screening (Visit 1): acute myocardial infarction.

data.text: Approximately 1035 participants randomly assigned to placebo, eloralintide 1.5 mg, 3 mg, 6 mg, 9 mg at a ratio of 2:1:2:2:2; an upper limit of approximately 70% enrollment of AFAB participants will be used to ensure a sufficient number of AMAB participants.

data.name: Unscheduled Visit Condition
data.description: Investigator_driven visit condition
data.text: An unscheduled visit may occur per investigator discretion for clinical oversight; the study site will determine if fasting status is needed prior to the visit. Concomitant medications, AEs, and endpoint events are required and should be recorded in the CRF.

data.name: Early Discontinuation Visit Condition
data.description: Condition for performing a scheduled visit as an ED visit
data.text: If the participant is discontinuing at the time of a scheduled visit, perform that visit as an ED visit.

data.name: Exemption from ED Procedures
data.description: Condition exempting participants from early discontinuation procedures
data.text: Participants who withdraw from the study after signing the informed consent but who have not taken a dose of study intervention do not need to complete ED procedures.

data.name: Screening to Treatment (Randomization) Transition
data.text: Following an up to 35_day screening period (Visit 1 to Visit 3), participants meeting all eligibility criteria (including PHQ_9 <15 at Visit 3 and baseline fundus photography prior to randomization) are randomized at Visit 3 to placebo or eloralintide 1.5/3/6/9 mg (2:1:2:2:2).

data.name: Dose Escalation to Maintenance Transition
data.text: After the 12_week dose escalation period (dose stepping every 4 weeks through 3 mg, 6 mg, 9 mg), participants enter the 52_week treatment maintenance period at the randomly assigned dose.

data.name: Treatment to Post_treatment Follow_up Transition
data.text: After completion of the 64_week treatment period (or final treatment visit), participants enter a 6_week post_treatment follow_up period with Visit 801 occurring approximately 6 weeks after the last treatment period visit; all participants are required to complete the safety follow_up visit.

data.name: Dose Escalation Regimen
data.text: To reach doses of 3 mg, 6 mg, and 9 mg QW, a dose_escalation regimen stepping through each of these doses every 4 weeks will be employed.

data.name: Dose Modification for Tolerability
data.text: Dose modification (Section 6.6) may be applied for management of intestinal symptoms, inadequate nutrition or dehydration, BMI <=22 kg/m2, or perceived excessive weight reduction.

data.name: Temporary Study Intervention Interruption
data.text: Temporary study intervention interruption may occur per Section 7.1.2 and hepatic safety criteria in Section 8.2.9.

data.name: Glycemic Rescue Therapy
data.text: For severe, persistent hyperglycemia, recommended glycemic rescue therapy may be initiated; urgent use of short_term insulin in a hospital or closely monitored setting may be used as rescue therapy. Participants must continue administering assigned study intervention unless insulin is used as short_term rescue therapy.

data.name: Discontinuation of Study Intervention for Liver Chemistry
data.text: Study intervention must be discontinued if liver chemistry stopping criteria are met (Section 7.1.1 and Section 8.2.9).

data.name: Prohibited Insulin Use Leading to Intervention Change
data.text: Insulin use for >=14 consecutive days is prohibited during the study (initiation of new antihyperglycemic medications, Section 6.9.1).

data.name: Participant Discontinuation/Withdrawal from Study
data.text: Participants may discontinue study intervention or withdraw from the study per Section 7.1 and Section 7.2; those permanently discontinuing early complete ED visits and posttreatment follow_up visit(s).

data.name: Early Discontinuation (ED) Visit
data.description: ED visits will be completed by participants permanently discontinuing early from the study; these participants should also complete posttreatment follow_up visit(s). If discontinuing at the time of a scheduled visit, that visit is performed as an ED visit.

data.name: Withdrawal Before First Dose
data.description: Participants who withdraw after signing informed consent but who have not taken a dose of study intervention do not need to complete ED procedures.

data.name: Screen Failure
data.description: Participants who do not meet eligibility criteria during the up to 35_day screening period (Visit 1 to Visit 3), e.g., fasting glucose >270 mg/dL, eGFR <30 mL/min/1.73 m2, or PHQ_9 >=15, do not proceed to randomization.

data.name: Lost to Follow_up
data.description: Participants lost to follow up are handled per Section 7.3.

data.name: Study Completion
data.description: Completion of the 64_week treatment period (12_week dose escalation plus 52_week maintenance) and the 6_week posttreatment follow_up, including the required safety follow_up Visit 801 approximately 6 weeks after the last treatment visit.

data.name: Randomization Eligibility Decision at Visit 3
data.description: At Visit 3 (within 35 days of Visit 1), eligibility is confirmed (including PHQ_9 <15 and baseline fundus photography) prior to randomization to placebo or eloralintide 1.5/3/6/9 mg at 2:1:2:2:2.

data.name: Screening Laboratory Eligibility Decision at Visit 1
data.description: Central laboratory and assessment_based eligibility determination at screening (Visit 1).

data.name: Dose Escalation Decision Every 4 Weeks
data.description: Every 4 weeks during the 12_week escalation period, dose is stepped up unless tolerability/dose modification criteria apply.

data.name: Glycemic Rescue Decision
data.description: Decision point during treatment visits for initiation of rescue therapy for severe, persistent hyperglycemia while continuing assigned study intervention.

data.name: Hepatic Safety Interruption/Discontinuation Decision
data.description: Decision point for temporary interruption or permanent discontinuation of study drug based on liver chemistry stopping criteria.
